BiblicalUsage: Here is rôkeç: it means a snare (as of tied meshes). It stands in Psalms 31:20: "…pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God put rôkeç here on purpose, and I take his word for it.
